plan: [ This is a sealed-bid second-price auction. With private, independently drawn values and no learning history, the dominant strategy is to bid my true value. Bidding my value ($23) guarantees: if I win, I pay the second-highest bid, which is ≤ my bid, ensuring nonnegative profit; if I lose, profit is zero. With one round and unknown opponents, truthful bidding maximizes expected profit. ]
